usedFor: Shopify holds products, and TimeCamp gets a task through “Create Task” after each “New Product”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Task” in TimeCamp
bestTemplate.why: Every new product opens a task in a specific project, so launch work is tracked.

watchOut: “Create Task” goes into one specific project, so choose it before “New Product” runs.
